results.title: Amnesty International: It's Time to Abolish ICE
results.description: Amnesty International says Immigration and Customs Enforcement needs to be abolished, not reformed. In a new report titled "We Had Whistles, They Had Guns," the group alleges systemic human rights abuses by ICE during large-scale enforcement operations under President Trump's immigration agenda," Le Monde reports.
